name: gsb.lock
description: Reviewed compatibility tuple for the Governed Second Brain stack. The build records the registrar source revision and runtime bundle SHA-256; CI verifies the shipped bundle and exercises capture, govern and audit. The optional compiler version is a compatibility baseline, not an enforced installer pin; qmd is an external prerequisite. Bump deliberately and re-run the full-chain smoke.

plugin.name: governed-second-brain
plugin.role: Claude Code plugin — ONE plugin, two modes (local in-process stdio MCP read+write; team remote proxy over the tailnet, read+propose). Dispatched by TEAMKB_API_URL. Plus the npx installer.

compile.name: bobs-big-brain-compiler
compile.role: ICO optional corpus -> governance spool. Installer full mode explicitly selects DeepSeek; --index-only skips compilation. Version is a compatibility baseline for the ^1.14.0 fallback range, not a measured installed version.

govern.name: bobs-big-brain-registrar
govern.role: INTKB — deterministic dedupe -> policy -> promote + the SHA-256 hash-chained audit + external anchor; dense retrieval default-on (#328/#334). Public monorepo; compiled into plugin-runtime/governed-brain.cjs, never published to a registry.

retrieve.name: qmd
retrieve.role: tobi's qmd — on-device hybrid search (BM25 + vector + LLM rerank). External PATH prerequisite; every hit is a qmd:// citation. Govern degrades gracefully if absent (capture/promote/audit still complete; only the post-promote index refresh waits).

nativeDependencies.name: better-sqlite3
nativeDependencies.role: local store (SQLite) — externalized from the bundle, native-built by the installer

nativeDependencies.name: fs-ext
nativeDependencies.role: flock(2) wrapper for the local-mode write lock — serializes ~/.teamkb writes against the cron's /usr/bin/flock (R9). Externalized from the bundle, native-built by the installer.

nativeDependencies.name: sqlite-vec
nativeDependencies.role: SQLite extension for the dense retrieval sidecar (EmbeddingGemma KNN) — externalized from the bundle; without it DenseVecIndex construction throws and the dense arm silently degrades to lexical (the gybo.4 root cause)

verifiedBy: .github/workflows/smoke.yml — capture -> govern -> audit-verify (hermetic, zero LLM egress) + best-effort qmd-cited search.
